historical_context.time_period: Contemporary Sa'ueia nomadic cycle; one daily Umbros eclipse
historical_context.location: The lantern-side warm hollow of a Sa'ueia breeding ground, beside a glassback calving lane and candle fungal road.
historical_context.summary: An outgoing caretaker transfers a Sa'ueia child and a glassback calf from a shared brood ring into a mobile family and returning herd. The scene tests whether kinship survives separation as portable care, reciprocal route obligation, or a jointly paid escort rather than becoming custody.

public_facts.text: Sa'ueia breeding grounds hold infancy, infirm care, reproductive continuity, legal memory, and ecological partnership without becoming permanent capitals.
Sa'ueia family units are small mobile kin, care, craft, defense, education, and diplomatic bodies whose status depends on ecological partners remembering them as beneficial.
Glassbacks exchange heat and low-grade memory gradients through translucent dorsal plates, protect calves, and can fog or darken plates, refuse routes, or form calf rings under pressure.
Brood rings make reciprocal care between young Sa'ueia and allied young organisms into obligations that continue after their routes separate.
Umbros is an enormous fixed world in the sky, and regular eclipses create local light, heat, movement, and ecological timing pressure.

ambient_pressures.text: Family and herd both need a limited post-eclipse movement window, so waiting, escorting, and detouring spend real route time and nourishment opportunity.
A care record is useful testimony but does not replace a receiving adult's ability to read refusal and perform body-specific care.
Keeping young together forever would be as coercive as forcing them apart early; the live obligation is to make eventual separation survivable without erasing either future.

groups.label: Lantern-side brood ring
institutional_logic: Teach young bodies one another's care and refusal signals, then convert that familiarity into portable obligations before their routes separate.
material_incentives: Share glassback heat during eclipse, protect calves and children, distribute grooming labor, and leave each young traveler with more than one ecology able to recognize distress.
internal_shames: Treating a care record as competence
Favoring the Sa'ueia child over the allied calf
Keeping a maturing young body as proof of generosity
prestige_markers: A later route obligation honored without supervision
A young person whose stop signal survives handover
taboo_triggers: Adult schedules presented as natural law
emotional_display_norms: Affection appears through warmth, grooming, waiting, rest calls, tolerated proximity, and remembered routes more often than formal declarations.
trust_defaults: Trusts practiced care and received refusal over archive recital; expects both family and herd to pay ongoing costs.
speech_register_cues: Silence used to make room for a young person's signal

groups.label: Incoming Sa'ueia mobile family unit
institutional_logic: Receive a young traveler without severing the ecological relationships that helped raise them.
material_incentives: Leave within the route window, reach owed shelters, gain a route-capable young member, and preserve standing with herd, road, and breeding ground.
internal_virtues: Tools and archives balanced on the body
Young travelers moving by their own capacity
internal_shames: Claiming kinship while exporting its labor
prestige_markers: Returning to a breeding ground in good standing
taboo_triggers: A caretaker implying the family owns the breeding ground
A route adult treating ecological obligations as nursery sentiment
emotional_display_norms: Urgency is compressed into route calculations; affection remains practical and visible in pacing, load, posture, and who is allowed to refuse contact.
trust_defaults: Trusts route history and repeated acts, but must learn the exact care relationship held by this brood ring.
speech_register_cues: Care promises stated as who will do what and where

groups.label: Returning glassback herd
institutional_logic: Receive a calf into herd heat and route life while testing whether Sa'ueia care has respected glassback signals.
material_incentives: Protect calves, reach feeding access, preserve heat, avoid panic contagion, and maintain profitable routes with Sa'ueia partners.
internal_shames: Allowing schedule pressure to fracture herd calm
prestige_markers: Honest-water guidance repaid by Sa'ueia defense and grooming
taboo_triggers: Using readable plate states for ambush or status extraction
emotional_display_norms: Heat, color, fogging, broadside stance, spacing, and route movement carry public feeling and boundary signals.
trust_defaults: Cooperates after calm approach, parasite removal, calf rescue, and respectful distance during plate exchange.
speech_register_cues: No Sa'ueia dialogue assigned; scene interpretation stays with visible plate patterns, movement, heat transfer, and route response.

groups.label: Warm-hollow road and lantern partners
institutional_logic: Keep eclipse movement and infant shelter viable while remembering whether travelers feed, protect, contaminate, or overrun local boundaries.
material_incentives: Receive clean organic matter, route discipline, pollen and spore movement, protected roots, and traffic that does not endanger the commons.
internal_shames: A bright path that leads into harm
Shelter granted to someone who damages the nursery
prestige_markers: A sheltered young body returned safely
taboo_triggers: Travelers treating living signals as inert signage
emotional_display_norms: Approval and refusal appear as lantern color, fungal brightness, darkness, route opening, and route closure.
trust_defaults: Rewards repeated conduct; withholds access when obligations are broken.
speech_register_cues: No verbal dialogue; signals remain colored light, route geometry, taste, and timing.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Kinship is tested by whether incoming caretakers can recognize and obey the young body's refusal, not whether they possess the correct record.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make choices turn on waiting, touch distance, fogged plates, facial-fan signals, and demonstrated care rather than abstract declarations of love.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A shared escort or patient handover spends feeding light, shelter timing, and caretaker stamina; delay is care only when someone owns its bill.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Every patient option must name who arrives late, works longer, grazes later, or acquires a future care debt.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The ring succeeds when belonging survives distinct futures; permanent physical togetherness is not the measure and can become custody.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Allow a well-prepared clean separation to be a genuine good ending, while premature separation remains materially harmful.

observer_read: A nursery attachment that should yield to route life
Useful care history already captured by the archive
target_self_read: Body knowledge that must be practiced
Future obligations extending beyond the hollow
misread_patterns: Treats record transfer as care transfer
Reads a young person's refusal as fear to overcome
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep Doro competent but initially tempted to compress care into a portable record and departure time.

target_self_read: Responsible family receiving a young traveler
Route debtor with legitimate timing pressure
misread_patterns: Herd alarm can flatten individual Sa'ueia intent
Sa'ueia can read public plate states as complete consent
likely_insults: No translated verbal insults; refusal appears as fogged plates, calf-ring closure, and denied route cooperation.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let glassback response remain visibly agentic without translating it into omniscient human-like dialogue.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A Sa'ueia caretaker ending a long watch while holding temporary authority over the manner, not the ownership, of departure.
available_masks: Silence that leaves room for a young signal
failure_modes: Using authority to force a tidy split
Treating ecological witnesses as decorative approval

role_pressure_fields.summary: A mobile-family adult who must receive a young Sa'ueia as an agent with existing more-than-species kinship, not as transferable cargo.
obligations: Leave room for the child's chosen body distance
failure_modes: Accepting the object while missing the care

role_pressure_fields.summary: A young Sa'ueia leaving the breeding ground with enough agency to signal refusal, choose departure order, and preserve a cross-species bond.
obligations: No adult-authored duty beyond what the scene makes observable; the young person's role is to signal needs and participate in departure.
failure_modes: Being treated as the proof that adults handled the ritual well

role_pressure_fields.summary: A glassback adult receiving a calf through visible heat, plate, spacing, and route signals while protecting herd feeding and calm.
obligations: Respond to learned privacy and grooming signals
failure_modes: Sa'ueia observers mistaking readable plates for total transparency

known_context.text: Pera knows the shared grooming, rest, privacy, and distress signals practiced by Tavi and Low Ember, plus the breeding ground's routes and current eclipse window.

beliefs.text: Pera believes care has transferred only when an incoming adult can receive refusal and perform the relevant body-specific routine.

misreads.text: Pera may overestimate how much patient ritual the route window and tired bodies can afford.

must_not_know.text: Pera cannot know the future behavior of Doro's family, Broad Rain's herd, or the living road beyond what current signals and remembered obligations support.

known_context.text: Doro knows the family's route obligations, the departure window, and the archive contents offered during handover.

beliefs.text: Doro initially believes a good archive and practical competence may be enough to make the transition clean.

misreads.text: Doro may read a cross-species brood bond as temporary nursery attachment rather than a source of lasting route debt.

must_not_know.text: Doro cannot treat glassback plate states as complete inner truth or assign Sa'ueia speech to the herd.

author_only_boundaries.text: Pera, Doro, Tavi, Low Ember, Broad Rain, and the exact warm-hollow event are story-local names and events, not promoted Zyphos canon.
The authored brood-ring rule is canonical only as the plainly marked Ghostlight elaboration in the family-unit note; scene-specific dialogue, route timing, and outcomes remain fixture branches.

open_questions.question: What exact adult and juvenile glassback silhouette should become the durable species visual reference?
open_questions.notes: The fixture stays within low broad grazer bodies, translucent dorsal heat plates, muzzle interaction, and herd spacing. A later visual-design pass should establish exact limb count, joints, and scale before high-consistency rendering.

open_questions.question: How long do brood-ring obligations typically persist, and who arbitrates competing claims between a mobile family and herd?
open_questions.notes: This bounded pass establishes that the obligations persist into later routes without fixing a universal term, duration, or court.
